session_id.Description: A session identifier of the form ses-<label>, matching a session found in the dataset. There MUST be exactly one row for each session. Values in session_id MUST be unique.

dissociated_cell_sample_nhash_id.Description: Identifier (NHash ID) of the dissociated cell sample profiled in this session.

tissue_sample_brain_structure_id.Description: Ontology identifier for the brain structure from which the tissue sample was taken.

dandi_file_uri.Description: DANDI Archive asset download URI for the data file associated with this session.

nemo_fastq_file_uris.Description: List of NeMO Archive URIs for the raw FASTQ file(s) associated with this session.

bil_tif_file_uri.Description: Brain Image Library (BIL) URI to the folder containing the TIF image data for this session.

bil_swc_file_uri.Description: Brain Image Library (BIL) URI to the folder containing the SWC reconstruction data for this session.

library_aliquot_nhash_id.Description: Optional identifier (NHash ID) of the library aliquot associated with this session.

dissociated_cell_sample_local_name.Description: Optional human-readable local name of the dissociated cell sample.
